subject: 12 in a row using Premium picks
body_paragraphs: Quick story. A user named Marcus emailed me last week. He'd been using free Predictify for two months — hit-or-miss results, mostly entertainment. Then he tried Premium for one week. Twelve correct predictions in a row. Including four of the >85% confidence picks that are Premium-only.

He told me: 'I almost canceled day one because I thought it was just the free version with extra graphs. Then I realized — the high-confidence picks are completely different. Those are the ones the AI is most certain about, and they hit harder than I expected.'

Most free users never see this difference because they don't try it. The Premium trial is 7 days, no card charged until day 8. If it works for you the way it worked for Marcus, you'll know within the first weekend of matches.
Open the app, tap Premium, start the free trial. P.S. If you cancel before day 7 you keep all the predictions you've already made — the trial isn't a trap, it's a test drive.
